name: C2PA Content Credentials
description: C2PA 2.1 content credentials: generate, sign (Ed25519) and embed provenance manifests on digital objects (JUMBF via c2patool, PDF associated files, or .c2pa.json sidecars), record signed digitisation provenance automatically when a digital object is created, sign manifests for AI outputs, carry embedded EXIF/IPTC/XMP as C2PA metadata assertions, declare an AI training and data-mining stance, and verify manifests on public pages. Shares its signing key chain with the AI Compliance plugin.
author: The Archive and Heritage Group

suggests.ahgAiCompliancePlugin: Provides the shared Ed25519 signing key (ai_inference_key + data/ai-keys) used to sign and verify C2PA manifests
suggests.ahgDAMPlugin: Provides dam_iptc_metadata used for stds.iptc / stds.xmp Standard Metadata Assertions
suggests.ahgAIPlugin: Signs a C2PA manifest for each AI output (NER, summary, translation, HTR, description suggestion)

external_binaries.c2patool: Optional. When present (/usr/local/bin/c2patool or on PATH), enables JUMBF embedding of manifests into JPEGs. Absent: manifests are written as .c2pa.json sidecars.
